parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
State or imply angle $AOC=\pi-2\theta$. [B1] Guidance: Might be seen on the printed diagram.
Use correct formulae for the area of a sector and triangle, or of a segment, and find the area of the shaded region. [M1] Guidance: $\frac12r^2(\pi-2\theta)-\frac12r^2\sin(\pi-2\theta)$, or $\frac12\pi r^2-[\frac12r^2(2\theta)+\frac12r^2\sin(\pi-2\theta)]$. M0 if subtraction is the wrong way round.
Equate to $\frac16\pi r^2$ and obtain a correct equation in any form. [A1] Guidance: e.g. $\frac16\pi r^2=\frac12r^2(\pi-2\theta)-\frac12r^2\sin(\pi-2\theta)$.
Obtain $\theta=\frac13(\pi-1.5\sin2\theta)$ correctly. [A1] Guidance: AG. Condone if state or imply $\sin(\pi-2\theta)=\sin2\theta$.
[Total: 4]

parts.label: (b)
parts.answer: At $\theta=0.5$, the right-hand side is $0.626$; at $\theta=0.7$, it is $0.554$. Hence $0.5<\theta<0.7$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Evaluate a relevant expression or pair of expressions at $\theta=0.5$ and $\theta=0.7$. [M1] Guidance: Allow work on a smaller interval. Need to evaluate for both limits, with at least one correct. When using $x=f(x)$, embedded values are not sufficient; e.g. $f(0.5)\ldots$ is accepted but $\frac13(\pi-1.5\sin(2\times0.5))=\ldots$ is not.
Complete the argument correctly with correct calculated values. [A1] Guidance: e.g. $0.5<0.626$, $0.7>0.554$, or $0.126>0$, $-0.146<0$. If using pairs, the pairing must be clear. Need to see the inequalities or an appropriate comment. Need values calculated to at least 2 sf.
[Total: 2]

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use the iterative process $\theta_{n+1}=\frac13(\pi-1.5\sin2\theta_n)$ correctly at least once. [M1] Guidance: i.e. obtain one value and use that value to obtain a second value. Must be working in radians.
Obtain final answer $0.586$. [A1]
Show sufficient iterations to 5 d.p. to justify $0.586$ to 3 d.p., or show there is a sign change in the interval $(0.5855,0.5865)$. [A1] Guidance: e.g. $0.5,0.62646,0.57225,0.59195,0.58416,0.58715,0.58599,0.58644$; or $0.6,0.58118,0.58833,0.58553,0.58661,0.58619,0.58636$; or $0.7,0.55447,0.59958,0.58133,0.58827,0.58556,0.58661,0.58620,0.58636$. Allow working to more than 5 d.p., but not less.
[Total: 3]
